name: MobyGames
tagline: Historical game catalog with platforms, covers, credits, and companies
description: MobyGames API provides access to a deep historical catalog of video games including platforms, cover art, credits, and company relationships. Developers can query game metadata for catalogs, research tools, and game-related applications.

auth.details: API key required; pass as query parameter or header per current docs.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free access requires application and approval for non-commercial research; non-commercial access is limited to 720 requests/hour, averaging one every 5 seconds, with a maximum of 1 request/second.

rate_limits: Published and plan-dependent: non-commercial access is 720 requests/hour with a 1 request/second maximum; legacy access is 360/hour; paid plans advertise limits from 0.2 to 8 requests/second.
use_cases: look up a game by title and platform
fetch cover art and release metadata for a catalog
list credits and companies for a game
search historical game releases by year or platform
